pages.title: Not Printable
pages.text: $(l)Not Printable$() means the machine will $(l)never$() print it: no FU value in strict mode, or a spool or restricted trophy.$(br2)Some treasure is $(l)wind-only$(): saddles, name tags and the dragon egg recycle but never print.$(br2)Above the machine's tier reads $(l)Requires a Tier N Printer$().
